One of Tibia's most famous quests: descend to the {wiki:Pits of Inferno|Pits of Inferno}, beneath the Plains of Havoc, cross the Hall of the Five Ways with a team of all vocations, solve the levers, the spa and the maze and enter the throne rooms of the {wiki:Ruthless Seven|Ruthless Seven}. Absorb the spirit of the seven thrones to open the treasure room, where you receive {item:Soft Boots}, {item:Backpack of Holding}, {item:Stuffed Dragon}, {item:Frozen Starlight}, 100 platinum coins and choose between {item:Arcane Staff}, {item:Avenger} or {item:Arbalest}.

The once-glorious Nightmare Knights settled beneath the burning Pits of Inferno to fight evil. However, the Pits of Inferno guard thrones that hold a little of the spirit of each of the Ruthless Seven. Absorb their spirit to claim your prize!

Mission 7 of The Inquisition Quest (Demon Forge)
When you absorb the spirit of at least one of the {wiki:The Ruthless Seven|Ruthless Seven}.
You also must have reported Ungreez's mission in the Inquisition.
Bring **plenty** of flasks of {item:Blood} and {item:Oil}: if someone makes a mistake or the bridge closes, you will need more.
Bring plenty of {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field Runes}: fire fields appear over the entrance hole, the levers and the rope holes.
Use {item:Dwarven Ring|Dwarven Rings}: many monsters make you drunk.

After stepping on each throne, check in the {wiki:Quest Log|Quest Log} that it is done. Step on each throne **twice**: if you are pushed back with the message *'Begone!'*, that throne is already done.
As soon as you **enter** a throne room, you gain access to a teleport shortcut to the main room, in the {wiki:Necromant House|Necromant House}. Useful if you have to do the quest in several trips.
Before going in you need two things: the {item:Key 3700} (the key to the treasure room) and the {item:Holy Tible} (to pass the Shrine of Wonders).
Go to the hole south-west of Venore
Leave **Venore** by the south exit and walk **south-west**. Next to a small puddle of water you find a covered hole. Use the {item:Shovel} to open it and go down.
Where to get Key 3700 (south of Venore) and the Holy Tible (next to the Knightwatch Tower)
Kill the monsters and open the chest to the **north**. You receive {item:Key 3700} (it shows up as *crystal key*).
To leave, go back to where you fell and climb up the same hole with the {item:Rope}. You are south of **Venore** again, near the puddle of water.
Get to the Plains of Havoc

The {wiki:Plains of Havoc|Plains of Havoc} are **south-west of Venore**: leave the city and walk south-west. The Plains of Havoc temple (where {npc:Oldrak} is) is the landmark: the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower|Knightwatch Tower} is in the south of the Plains and the {wiki:Necromant House|Necromant House} is east of the Dark Cathedral.
Plains of Havoc map: 1. Temple, 2. Necromant House, 5. Knightwatch Tower

On the Plains of Havoc there are {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes}, {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Dragon|Dragons} west of the temple. Be careful if you are low level.
Climb the mountain next to the Knightwatch Tower

Go to the small mountain very close to the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower|Knightwatch Tower}, south of the Plains of Havoc temple. To climb up you need to use {spell:Levitate} or stack 3 {item:Parcel|Parcels}. Inside there is a chest with the {item:Holy Tible} (a book that looks like the old {item:T-Book}). Open it. To leave, go back down the mountain the same way you climbed up (with {spell:Levitate}, use *exani hur down* facing downhill).
Gather the rest of the equipment and the team

Make sure you have: {item:Shovel}, {item:Rope}, {item:Pick}, {item:Holy Tible}, several flasks of {item:Blood} and {item:Oil}, {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field Runes} and that at least one person in the team has {item:Key 3700}. The team needs **one Knight, one Paladin, one Sorcerer, one Druid and one Monk** for the flames part.

On {wiki:Optional PvP|Optional PvP} worlds players can stack on the same tile and pass the grave together with a single flask of blood. On {wiki:Hardcore PvP|Hardcore PvP} or Open PvP (no dove) each player has to bring their own blood.
2. Necromant House to the Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair

Go to the graveyard of the {wiki:Plains of Havoc|Plains of Havoc}, near the {wiki:Necromant House|Necromant House} (south-west of Venore), and use the {item:Shovel} on a {item:Loose Stone Pile} (there are several, all leading to the same narrow cave).
Opening the hole with the Pick
In the **east** part of the cave there is a 3x4 room. Use the {item:Pick} on the **north-west corner** of that room and go down the hole that opens.

When you land, {wiki:Goshnar|Goshnar}'s grave is directly **west**. Stand **1 sqm south** of the tombstone and use the {item:Blood} on the tombstone. All players on that tile are taken to the catacombs.
Bring extra blood in case someone misses the tile.

Entrance: use blood on Goshnar's tombstone (standing south of it), pass the Shrine of Wonders with the Holy Tible, enter the Pits of Inferno (level 30 expertise door, to the east), put oil on and pull the bridge lever, and break the stone with the Pick if there is lava

Go **north** (to the south there are {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}, but they are not part of the quest). Before the {item:Magic Wall} there is a floor tile with inscriptions: step on it with the {item:Holy Tible} in your backpack and you are taken to the other side.
Free Account players cannot get past this wall.
(Optional) Drink from the Well of Life
Go down the hole to the **north** into a small garden with the {wiki:Well of Life|Well of Life}. Drink from it: it restores your health once and you earn the achievement **Fountain of Life**.
Go down to the Pits of Inferno
To the **east** there is a sign that says *"To the Pits of Inferno"*. Go down that hole and head **south** to a bridge.
If the bridge is whole, cross it. If it is broken, use the {item:Oil} on the {item:Lever|lever} that is **south of the bridge, on the west side**, pull it and cross.
If the bridge collapses with you on the other side, the only way back is through the {wiki:Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair|dragon lair}! You can throw oil to the other side if your team needs it.

Next you see a river of lava or floor of already cooled lava. If there is lava, use the {item:Pick} on the stone next to it to cool it. Cross until you find **3 holes**, which all lead to the {wiki:Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair|Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair}.

Get ready for many {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and go down the **north** hole (the one closest to the quest area). To the **east** there is a rope hole: climb up with the {item:Rope} and you reach a room full of purple fires, the Hall of the Five Ways.
If there are fire fields on top of a hole or rope hole, use a {item:Destroy Field Rune}.
3. Hall of the Five Ways (one vocation per path)

There are five paths with purple fires. One player of each vocation has to cross **their** path and pull a lever at the end. On the right path each fire takes 300 HP; on the wrong path the damage **increases with each fire** until it kills you. If you are on the wrong path you get a warning message.
Choose the path for your vocation
The hall is at this spot. Each player follows the path of their vocation:
If you get the wrong-path message, turn back immediately: the damage doubles with each fire.
Hall of the Five Ways: Paladin south-east (1st flame), Knight north (2nd), Sorcerer south (3rd), Druid east-north-east (4th), Monk west (5th)
Damage on the wrong path (original vocations)

For Knight, Paladin, Sorcerer and Druid, this is the damage per tile if you take the wrong path (it does not apply to the Monk path). A {item:Stone Skin Amulet} reduces physical damage, **but on the last tile (11) do not use the Stone Skin Amulet**: without it, that tile deals no physical damage at all.

The {wiki:Monk|Monk} path is different: it has **13 tiles** instead of 11 and the physical damage keeps doubling, so the last tile deals 300 fire + 51,200 physical damage. Here the special last-tile rule does **not** apply: **you can use the Stone Skin Amulet on the last tile**, which reduces the damage to 10,240 (and even less with more physical resistance items).
So the Monk path can be opened by another vocation with enough physical resistance and enough health/mana to withstand 5,000–10,000 physical damage.
Go up and pull the lever
At the end of the path go up through the rope hole. You reach a room with 3 creatures and a lever. You do not need to kill the monsters: just **pull the lever**.

Knights and Paladins have trouble killing the Spectre: the best thing is to run away from it. Druids can kill the Diabolic Imp with {item:Sudden Death Rune|SD} and then the Spectre. Use a {item:Dwarven Ring}.
When all five levers have been pulled, the fire walls disappear. Move **the whole team** to the main area, known as "PoI levers".
The fire walls close again when the stones disappear (in the next part). Make sure everyone is on the other side before continuing.

If the team has to leave and the walls are already closed, there is an emergency exit on the **east** side of the flames. It takes you to the west side and from there you leave through the dragon lair.
4. The levers (PoI levers) and the Spa
Pull the 15 levers in the right order

The "PoI levers" area is at this spot and on the 3 floors below. There are 15 levers that have to be pulled **in the correct order**; this makes the final lever work for a short time. That final lever makes the 2 stones next to the entrance disappear and gives you access to a staircase. The order of the 15 levers is shown in the image below.

Here you find {creature:Spectre|Spectres}, {creature:Diabolic Imp|Diabolic Imps}, {creature:Defiler|Defilers}, {creature:Destroyer|Destroyers}, {creature:Hellfire Fighter|Hellfire Fighters}, {creature:Plaguesmith|Plaguesmiths} and {creature:Lost Soul|Lost Souls}. The Hellfire Fighters cover the levers with fire: use {item:Destroy Field Rune}.
Order of the 15 levers: pull them in the order shown
Go up the stairs and ignore the levers

Go up the stairs. You find 2 {creature:Blightwalker|Blightwalkers}, 15 levers and a book with a riddle. Read only the **first letter** of each line: it spells *"LEVERS USELESS"*. In other words, **all these levers are useless**, do not touch them.

After the stones there is an emergency exit, but beware: that teleport does **not** get you out of the PoI, it only takes you to the other side of the stones. A safer exit is the shortcut south of the 2 Blightwalkers.

The team has to split in two. One part stays in this room and has to hold off {creature:Defiler|Defilers}, {creature:Hellfire Fighter|Hellfire Fighters}, {creature:Betrayed Wraith|Betrayed Wraiths} and {creature:Blightwalker|Blightwalkers}. The other part goes to the {wiki:Pits of Inferno Spa|Pits of Inferno Spa}.
Open the hole to the Spa

One player stands **1 sqm south** of the stone in the centre of the room (the one with a skeleton on top). Another player goes **north** and pulls **both levers**. The hole that leads to the Spa opens.
In the Spa go to the **east** part and look for a tile on the floor. When someone stands on that tile, a staircase appears in the room where the other part of the team stayed.
Spa tile that makes the stairs appear
The stairs appear when a player steps on the switch in the Spa

In the Spa there are {creature:Diabolic Imp|Diabolic Imps}, {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares}, {creature:Defiler|Defilers}, {creature:Destroyer|Destroyers}, {creature:Hellfire Fighter|Hellfire Fighters}, {creature:Phantasm|Phantasms}, {creature:Dark Torturer|Dark Torturers}, {creature:Plaguesmith|Plaguesmiths}, {creature:Blightwalker|Blightwalkers} and {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils}.

The team that stayed in the lever room goes up the stairs and clears the room above. Then whoever is in the Spa comes back and stands on the tile where the stairs appeared, so those above can pull them up with the {item:Rope}.
Ignore the Demonguard and go up to the maze

You will find the NPC {npc:Demonguard}. He is of no use: if you talk to him, you catch fire. Go up again with the rope: the rope hole is **1 sqm north** of the hole that leads back down. You are now in the maze.
5. The maze and the point of no return

Walk through the maze until you reach a **dead end in the north-east part**. The maze has 10 zones; you must pass through at least 9, and each one is reached only by a teleport tile (teleport 1 leads to zone 2, teleport 2 to zone 3, and so on). There is only one right path, but some tiles send you to an earlier zone or back to the start. The best route is on the map below.

Watch where you step! Some tiles teleport you anywhere in the maze, including the start or 1 sqm from the hole that goes back to the Demonguard. None of them takes you out of the maze. Take your time.
According to the map: when you go up through the hole on the 'U' line, go to the **northernmost** hole to continue to the next zone of the maze (dashed purple line).

Right route through the maze: green letters = teleport tiles, dashed red lines = teleport destinations, yellow lines = path to follow (where the line ends, use the rope), yellow asterisks = tiles that send you back to the start
Use the Pick at the end of the maze
When **the whole team** is in the north-east dead end, use the {item:Pick} on the middle tile.
Pull the lever on the east path

In this area there are some {creature:Hellfire Fighter|Hellfire Fighters} and {creature:Magicthrower|Magicthrowers} that you have to withstand. At least one player takes the **east** path to the lever at the end (may need {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field Runes}) and pulls it: the stones disappear and the team goes through. If the stones come back, the lever has to be pulled again.

After killing the Hellfire Fighters, a mage can summon {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} to absorb the Magicthrowers' attacks. For the Magicthrowers to switch targets, the team has to go back up.
When the team goes up, they must wait by the stairs without moving! If they move, the stones come back and the lever has to be pulled again.
Pass the point of no return

Follow the short one-way path until you fall through a tile; then climb up again with the rope. **From here you cannot go back.** You see two holes: the **north** one leads to the {creature:Slime|Slimes} cave of the Plains of Havoc (with no way to get back in) and the **south** one leads to the depths of the PoI, where the {wiki:Ruthless Seven|Ruthless Seven} are.
Do not enter the north hole if you want to continue the quest.
Go down the **south** hole and search the skeleton. You receive a {item:Pirate Backpack} with:
Pirate Backpack with Ceremonial Ankh, Death Ring, Life Ring, pearls, runes and 11 platinum coins

Now choose: go back with this loot, or go through the **level 80 door** for the bigger prize. **If you want to leave here**, the exit is the **north** hole of the point of no return: it drops you in the {creature:Slime|Slimes} cave of the Plains of Havoc, from where you walk back to Venore (north-east). There is no way to get back in through that hole.
If you leave, you cannot come back through the exit: you would have to repeat all the steps from the PoI levers (you can use the shortcut to skip ahead to the Spa).

Go through the level 80 door and kill the creatures. Go down the stairs and head **north**. In that room there is a teleport to an identical room, with 2 {creature:Magicthrower|Magicthrowers}, some {creature:Hellfire Fighter|Hellfire Fighters} and a floor switch that sets the whole room on fire. When you enter that second room, a stone blocks whoever comes behind you: press the switch **several times** to let everyone through. When everyone is inside, continue north.

You reach the main room, with {creature:Phantasm|Phantasms}, {creature:Betrayed Wraith|Betrayed Wraiths}, {creature:Plaguesmith|Plaguesmiths}, {creature:Blightwalker|Blightwalkers} and a {creature:Hand of Cursed Fate}. Here there are **7 teleports** to the throne rooms of the Ruthless Seven and, to the north, **7 electric barriers** that only let you through to the reward room after you absorb the corresponding spirit.

According to a note from 15/01/2023, the main room spawn can be blocked by standing on the white marble tile between the two sandstone tiles (this does not include the Hellfire Fighters to the south). Otherwise, expect the monsters to respawn every time you return to the main room; when running a quest service, part of the team should stay behind to keep it clear.
The main room of the Pits of Inferno

In each throne room, clear the way and **step on the throne** to absorb a little of the spirit of that member of the Ruthless Seven. Then go back to the teleport. Check in the Quest Log and step on each throne **twice**: if you are pushed back with *'Begone!'*, that one is already done.

As soon as you **enter** (no need to complete) a throne room, you gain access to a shortcut teleport to the main room, in the {wiki:Necromant House|Necromant House}, one floor above ground level, behind a {item:Sealed Door|sealed door}. Absorbing at least one throne is also required to enter the {wiki:Demon Forge|Demon Forge} in the last mission of {wiki:The Inquisition Quest|The Inquisition Quest}.
The order is free. For each room: enter through the teleport, clear the way, step on the throne twice and go back to the teleport.

Go **south** and follow the path to the throne. Near the throne there are **invisible bridges** (over poison) that you have to walk across. Step on the throne twice to absorb the spirit of {wiki:Verminor|Verminor} and go back to the teleport.
{creature:Defiler|Defilers}, {creature:Plaguesmith|Plaguesmiths}, {creature:Son of Verminor|Sons of Verminor}, {creature:Blightwalker|Blightwalkers} and, sometimes, {creature:The Plasmother}.
Throne room of Verminor, the Plaguelord

The monsters often appear in large groups: walk slowly and try to pull them one at a time. Near the throne there is a switch hidden under fire: use a {item:Destroy Field Rune} to uncover it so you can reach the throne. Step on the throne twice to absorb the spirit of {wiki:Infernatil|Infernatil} and go back to the teleport.
Throne room of Infernatil, the arsonist of hell
Follow the path slowly so you do not pull too many creatures at once, until you reach the throne. Step on it twice to absorb the spirit of {wiki:Tafariel|Tafariel} and go back to the teleport.
{creature:Banshee|Banshees}, {creature:Dark Torturer|Dark Torturers}, {creature:Demon|Demons}, {creature:Lost Soul|Lost Souls} and, sometimes, {creature:Mr. Punish}.
Throne room of Tafariel, lady of the damned
Enter the **north** teleport of the main room: you appear on a wrecked ship. The room is relatively small. Step on the throne (preferably twice) to absorb the spirit of {wiki:Apocalypse|Apocalypse}.
Throne room of Apocalypse, total destruction

Enter the **north-east** portal. You reach a long corridor with 4 NPCs {npc:A Dead Bureaucrat}, numbered from **1 (southernmost) to 4 (northernmost)**. To enter the domain of {wiki:Pumin|Pumin} you need their authorisation. Talk to them **in exactly this order** (where it says *name* and *vocation*, type your character's name and your vocation):

These NPCs are "slow": sometimes they simply ignore you because they did not understand. If the answer is not the same as in the table, repeat the conversation with that bureaucrat before moving on to the next one.
Throne of Despair (Pumin): the throne room

When the team is ready, enter the **north** teleport to Pumin's domain. Move through the room carefully because of the **invisible walls** and step on the throne (preferably twice) to absorb Pumin's spirit.
{creature:Spectre|Spectres}, {creature:Betrayed Wraith|Betrayed Wraiths}, {creature:Demon|Demons}, {creature:Hand of Cursed Fate|Hands of Cursed Fate} and, rarely, {creature:The Handmaiden}.
Throne room of Pumin, the Lord of Despair

If the invisible walls get in your way, 'use' a distant tile and the server finds the fastest path on its own. The pillars support an invisible floor above: you can use {spell:Levitate} near the start and walk freely to the throne (but you will still have to kill most of the monsters). The NPC area is the only safe zone until the reward room.
Throne of Deceit (Bazir): warnings before the maze
In the domain of {wiki:Bazir|Bazir} you have to cross a {wiki:Maze of Bazir|maze} full of traps, with 3 floors. Read these warnings before you start:
**Always** check the minimap before going up a rope hole. The maze only has 3 floors: if you are on the 3rd floor, any rope hole takes you out, to the Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair, with no way back.
**Never** use a lever or a {item:Magic Forcefield} inside the maze: they can take you to the wrong places. Once pulled, levers stop working, so your teammates cannot use them to help you.

If part of the team is sent to the start of the maze, they can be pulled up with a rope to the second-to-last room (from the first room). There is no corresponding rope hole below, so someone must already have reached the end.

You can follow the pictures (recommended) or the table. In the pictures follow the **green lines**: they end at a hole or a rope spot, where you go up or down. When a line ends on a tile that is neither a hole nor a rope spot, you have reached the end. In the table, each row corresponds to a different room: after each one you go up or down through a hole.
Full map with instructions and rope holes
From the portal, go west through the fire fields, a few steps south and then east. Halfway east there is a rope hole (it may be covered by fire or junk). **Go up.**
**Go up** through the rope hole to the north-east.
Go south and west around the cave walls, then north. **Go down** through the hole.
Go south and **go down** through the hole (do **not** go up).
Always go south, a little west and south again. Follow the whole path east and then north. **Go up** through the hole.
**Go up** through the hole on the north side of the room.
Go west and then north-east. **Go down** through the hole on the **east** side of the cave.
Go a few squares west and north. **Go down** through the hole.
Go west and **go up** through the rope hole.
Go around the hole to the north and **go down** through the hole on the north side of the room.
Go north, a few squares east and north again. **Go up** through the rope hole (it may be hidden under a fire field).
Go north, east and then south. **Go up** through the rope hole on the **east** side of the cave (probably hidden under fire fields).
You are in the final room. Follow the next step.
Throne of Deceit (Bazir): after the maze
In the final room, pull the lever on the **south-east** side (it may be covered by an {creature:Orc} corpse). A teleport appears in the **south-west** hole: enter it to leave the maze. Then:
You are in a room with {item:Platinum Coin|platinum coins} on a higher floor, out of reach. Walk towards them and you are teleported to another room.
Go north to a {item:Magic Forcefield}. It is on a floor above: use {spell:Levitate} or look for the hidden staircase on the north-west side of the room. Enter the portal.
You are in a room surrounded by void. Walk towards the chest on the south or north side; before you get there you are teleported to the next room.
In a similar room, go to the **west** wall and use the blue tapestry to move it aside. A mirror appears: use it to enter the throne room.
Go to the middle of the north side. Step on the throne to absorb Bazir's spirit and step on it again to go back to the previous room.
To get out to the **main room**, step on the carpet next to the knight statue in the north-west (careful if the main room has not been cleared).
When you go through the teleport you appear in a graveyard. Walk **south** to the throne, step on it twice to absorb the spirit of {wiki:Ashfalor|Ashfalor} and go back to the teleport.

{creature:Lich|Liches}, {creature:Demon|Demons}, {creature:Undead Dragon|Undead Dragons} and, sometimes, {creature:Dracola} guarding the throne. Do not let the Undead Dragons catch the whole team with their waves.
Throne room of Ashfalor, Urgith's right hand and general of the undead hordes
Get past the barriers and open the door

In the main room go **north**, pass the 7 energy barriers and enter the teleport. After that there are many traps that take a little health: watch your HP. You reach a locked door with the NPC {npc:A Ghostly Sage} next to it. Ignore the NPC and open the door with {item:Key 3700}. Enter the teleport to the **south** to reach the reward room (north of the teleport there is a room similar to the dream machine, with a sword in the centre).
In the treasure room, walk **north**: there are five chests. Open them all.

{item:Backpack of Holding} with {item:Silver Rune Emblem (Ultimate Healing)}, {item:Silver Rune Emblem (Sudden Death)}, {item:Silver Rune Emblem (Explosion)} and {item:Silver Rune Emblem (Heavy Magic Missile)}
Soft Boots, Stuffed Dragon, Frozen Starlight, 100 platinum coins and Backpack of Holding with 4 Silver Rune Emblems
To the **west** there are three more chests, but you can only open **one**. Choose well:
Arcane Staff, Avenger or Arbalest (your choice)

To leave you have two options: go back through the realm of the Ruthless Seven and follow the signs that point to the exit, **or** talk to the NPC {npc:A Ghostly Sage}, who is right before the reward room, and ask him for a teleport. Either way you appear in the {creature:Slime|Slimes} cave under the Plains of Havoc; from there go up to the surface and walk **north-east** to Venore.

On later visits you do not need to repeat everything: in the {wiki:Necromant House|Necromant House}, one floor above the teleport to the Void, there is a {item:Sealed Door|sealed door} that only opens for those who have already entered a throne room. The teleport behind it takes you to the Hub Shortcut ({coord:32837,32235,13}), a safe room just before the main room. If you have done the {wiki:Dreamer's Challenge Quest|Dreamer's Challenge Quest} and carry an {item:Orichalcum Pearl}, you can also leave the Plains of Havoc through the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower|Knightwatch Tower} teleports (entrance through a hole under a tree next to the water, {coord:32816,32322,7}) to Thais, Carlin and other cities.
The exact order of the 15 levers of the PoI levers and the map with the route of the first maze are in the images of the corresponding steps (sections 4 and 5).
The stones of the PoI levers reappear after 15 minutes.
The NPC {npc:Demonguard} is useless: if you talk to him, you catch fire.
After entering a throne room, you can use the Necromant House shortcut to return directly to the main room (to hunt or check bosses).
